origin: OpenCode 1.18.16: the third request of a tool flow as the client sends it (cache_control on the messages and on the tool calls), with name, reasoning_content and refusal added to the assistant turn: derived. The capture asks for a Claude model; the model is changed to gpt-5.5 and reasoning_effort is the medium OpenCode sends for it (its verbosity field is left out, see extra-opencode-gpt-request-with-verbosity). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
